summary: Mr. Arking discusses the custom of repeating the Amidah if one accidentally says Melech Ohev Tzedakah Umishpat instead of HaMelech HaMishpat during the days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur. He reviews the opinions of various authorities, including the Shulchan Aruch and the Ben Ish Hai, and explains how the custom in Halabi communities has shifted over time.
questions: What should I do if I accidentally say Melech Ohev Tzedakah Umishpat during the ten days of repentance?
Do I have to repeat the entire Amidah if I miss the change to HaMelech HaMishpat?
Why did the custom in Halabi communities change regarding this repetition?
What is the difference between the Sephardic and Ashkenazic customs on this matter?
